notes.title: Announcement of Dragon Ruins II: Aftermath
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33855917/523548e115f78d4873c99631288effcc549838b0.png[/img]

We're excited to announce Dragon Ruins II: Aftermath, a standalone expansion for Dragon Ruins II.

Since it'll be a long time before a sequel enters production, we've decided to develop a standalone expansion for those who want more.

[h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Assemble a party of 4 adventurers from an expanded roster of classes
[*] Fight, loot, and explore your way through 15 new dungeons
[*] Enjoy two new weapon types (Greatswords and Spears) and a reworked upgrade system
[*] Shape your party into an unstoppable force with 20+ new skills
[*] Track down and hunt WANTED monsters for extra rewards
[*] Enjoy an expanded soundtrack with over an hour of new music on top of familiar tracks
[/list]

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819770/Dragon_Ruins_II_Aftermath/

notes.title: Announcement of Demon Lord Reincarnation Gaiden, our new game!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33855917/a484737fe45831d9d2243f9d53c1e355c7cce23d.png[/img]

We're excited to announce Demon Lord Reincarnation Gaiden, our new game.

Originally, this scenario was planned for a sequel, but it took off in its own direction and became an Ultima-style game with a new story. However, the initial draft was too good to abandon, so we turned it into a standalone expansion, similar to how Wizardry II was to the original Wizardry.

[h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enjoy a new scenario with new character classes and improved game systems
[*] Survive through brutal turn-based battles, where poor judgment can result in the permanent loss of a party member
[*] Unlock new skills in the heat of the battle, from devastating attacks to underhanded moves
[*] Inventory system with a variety of consumable items to buff, improve and customize your characters, including the ability to cheat death
[*] Come up with new party builds using new character classes and skills
[*] Find safe spots to regain your health and make sure the monsters won't get a drop on you
[*] Enjoy stylish visuals supported by atmospheric music and rocking battle tunes
[*] Read the manual, it's there for a reason!
[/list]

Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2783400/Demon_Lord_Reincarnation_Gaiden/

notes.title: Map Pack II is Out Now
notes.content:
Phantom 3D Map Pack II is available now. It offers 36 additional mazes, allowing more adrenaline-filled runs through the campaigns.

This map pack includes:
[list]
[*] 12 small levels
[*] 12 medium levels
[*] 12 large levels
[/list]

Enjoy!
